messages:
Mia (Design): Quick copy nit on the Confirm modal when removing a Dedicated pool. Current text: "This action will permanently delete the pool and its settings. Are you sure?"
Alex (Product): yeah saw that — what do you want to change?
Mia (Design): two problems: it's vague about what 'settings' means and there's no mention of fallbacks or safety. Users might think their models/data are gone.
Sam (PM): important — Dedicated pools have config and pinned model versions, but not customer data. Good catch.
Mia (Design): propose we make the consequence explicit and offer an undo window. Suggested copy (first line is heading):
```
Delete dedicated capacity
This will delete the pool configuration and any reserved capacity. Pinned model versions will be unlinked, but your hosted model artifacts and logs will remain. You can undo this action for 30 seconds.
```
Jordan (Eng): small nit: accessibility requires the time unit to be spoken clearly. Maybe say "for 30 seconds" rather than "for 30s". Also keyboard focus needs to land on Cancel, not Delete.
Mia (Design): yup used full words. Also added a subtle sentence about what is not deleted to reduce support tickets.
Alex (Product): I like the explicitness. Could we shorten the heading to "Delete capacity" to match other modals?
Mia (Design): "Delete capacity" works. Heading updated in the suggestion.
Sam (PM): add an icon or color to reinforce severity? Red button already but maybe a danger icon next to heading.
Jordan (Eng): feasible. We'll need a small a11y aria-label: `aria-label="Confirm delete dedicated capacity"`. I'll add in the PR.
Mia (Design): also propose microcopy for the undo snackbar: "Deletion scheduled. Undo" -> full suggestion: `Deletion scheduled. You can undo this action for 30 seconds.`
Alex (Product): perfect. Any objections?
Sam (PM): none. Approve from PM side. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Eng): will implement copy + focus change + aria label. Sending a draft PR shortly.
ui-bot: PR opened by @jordan: https://git.redwood/infer/pull/512 — includes modal copy, focus fix, and undo snackbar text.
Mia (Design): thanks! I'll review the PR and check QA on VO/JA screen readers tomorrow. :sparkles:
Alex (Product): will update release note entry: "Clarified delete modal for Dedicated capacity; added undo window."
Sam (PM): moving to inbox of design -> engineering handoff. Closing thread. :wave:
